label: Subweapon use MP instead of Hearts
summary: Alucard's subweapons and Agunea's follow-up strikes spend MP instead of hearts.

edits.why: Subweapon cost check (0x800FE528): addiu $a0,$a0,0x7BA8 (hearts) -> 0x7BB0 (MP); the same pointer is compared and subtracted.
EntitySubwpnAgunea follow-up strike cost pointer: hearts -> MP.

vanilla.reason: Two pointer immediates that hold the vanilla hearts address in every image.

notes: Heart costs in the subweapon table are used as MP costs. Richter's subweapons (RIC.BIN) still use hearts.
